description: Combine the remotely accepted guarded n=176/n=352 solver with the 64.628 us device-resident n=32 kernel: reconcile shared extension helpers and dispatch, preserve both larger custom-size certificates and selective fallback, add n=32 spectral stress coverage with residual certification or targeted fallback, and profile the integrated three-size path.

Merged the guarded n176/n352 solver and exact selective certificate with the fused device-resident n32 Householder/tridiagonal eigensolver. All 39 official tests pass; full geomean is 41682.470 us, with n32 64.647 us, n176 991.154 us, and n352 9765.307 us.

Applied the integrated exact Gram and eigen-residual certificate plus selective Xsyev repair to n32. All 39 tests pass; certificate GEMMs raise n32 from 64.647 to 109.535 us and full geomean from 41682.470 to 43446.045 us.

Replaced n32 certificate GEMMs with a direct one-warp-per-matrix kernel computing exact FP32 Gram and eigen residuals and selective repair flags. All tests pass, but serial column work raises n32 to 125.320 us and full geomean to 43870.303 us.

Parallelized the direct n32 certificate across 32 eight-lane groups and reduced each Gram/AQ dot with shuffles. Validation passes, but 256-thread certificate traffic raises n32 further to 129.507 us and full geomean to 44037.773 us.

Replaced full n32 residual certification with a one-warp spectral-gap guard that selectively repairs matrices whose independent inverse iterations are unsafe for clustered eigenvalues. All official tests pass; n32 improves from 129.507 to 98.977 us and full geomean to 43192.902 us.

Moved the n32 gap test into the fused CTA and apply two-pass shared-memory Gram-Schmidt only when eigenvalue separation is below 128 eps, avoiding host synchronization while repairing close invariant subspaces. All official tests pass; n32 is 69.980 us and full geomean 41975.530 us.

Extended official-eval n32 stress on 15 spectral families found failures in zero, identity, clustered, repeated, rank-deficient, near-rank, PSD, and extreme-magnitude matrices; close-spectrum Gram-Schmidt alone produced residual failures or NaNs. Dense/geometric, spectrum, band, and rowscale cases passed.

Moved n32 safety-flag synchronization and fallback dispatch into the C++ extension, falling back the full n32 batch when any matrix is unsafe. Official tests pass; the same 15-family stress suite passed on the classifier, but synchronous flag transfer leaves n32 at 98.915 us and full geomean 43148.404 us.

Replaced fused n32 plus synchronized guard with the parent 182-round all-device cyclic Jacobi kernel. Official tests pass and measured n32 is 91.180 us (full benchmark 42851.703 us), but extended stress failed dense geometric and low-magnitude spectra; 13/15 stress families passed.

Made cyclic n32 Jacobi rotation activation relative to matrix magnitude and ran seven full sweeps (217 rounds). All official tests and all 15 extended spectral families pass without fallback; n32 is 107.472 us and full geomean 43416.161 us.

Trimmed scale-relative cyclic n32 Jacobi from 217 to 200 rounds. All official tests and all 15 extended spectral families pass; dense geometric is the tightest at scaled eigen residual 84.5 versus limit 200. N32 is 99.573 us and full geomean 43165.099 us.

Reduced robust scale-relative cyclic n32 Jacobi from 200 to 190 rounds. Official tests pass and 14/15 stress families pass, but dense geometric fails at scaled eigen residual 328 versus limit 200; benchmark was not run after this validation failure.

Trimmed the scale-relative cyclic n32 Jacobi solver to 195 rounds. All official tests and all 15 extended spectral families pass; dense geometric and PSD are tightest at scaled residuals 130 and 128 versus limit 200. N32 is 97.340 us and full geomean 43097.331 us.

Reduced scale-relative cyclic n32 Jacobi from 195 to 193 rounds. All official tests and all 15 stress families pass, but dense geometric reaches scaled residual 195 versus limit 200; n32 is statistically unchanged at 97.283 us and full geomean measures 43145.556 us amid unrelated large-shape variance.

Restored the stress-clean 195-round scale-relative cyclic n32 solver after the 193-round point showed only five units of residual margin and no timing gain. Official tests pass; identical 195-round source passed all 15 stress families. N32 is 97.443 us and repeated full geomean 43202.022 us (prior identical-source run 43097.331 us).

Combined the two parents into merge commit da237ae8a6edd6fa22ddaeeea28e6bb33df97fc1 and preserved the n176/n352 custom solvers plus exact selective certificates. The raw fused n32 merge reached 41682.470 us and n32=64.647 us, but extended 15-family n32 stress exposed zero/repeated/clustered/rank-deficient/extreme-scale failures in the fused line. Exact residual certification cost n32=109.535 us; a spectral-gap Xsyev guard passed all stress cases at n32=98.977 us. Final stress-clean all-device commit d39aecfcc4277e9709a7a5a6bb589eab5d2f4396 uses a scale-relative 195-round cyclic Jacobi kernel: all 39 official tests and all 15 added spectral families pass, n32=97.443 us (prior identical-source 97.340 us), and full geomean measured 43202.022 us with a prior identical-source run of 43097.331 us. Final profiles show n32 is one 94.773 us cyclic kernel; n176 remains 467.938 us reduction + 393.554 us solve + 27.798 us certificate; n352 remains 4.415 ms reduction + 3.558 ms solve + 1.249 ms panel + 74.786 us certificate. Please keep the tree moving: concrete openings are an in-CTA hybrid that runs the 64.6-us fused solver then invokes cyclic refinement only for unsafe spectra without host synchronization, per-round active-pair convergence to avoid all 195 cyclic rounds on ordinary matrices, input power-of-two normalization around the fused solver for extreme scales, and a device-side selective fallback that preserves mixed-batch fast matrices.
